rounds.q: What % of an adult human body is water?
rounds.why: Even your bones are about 31% water, and babies are born at about 78%.
rounds.src: USGS Water Science School, The Water in You

rounds.q: What % of your 206 bones are in your hands and feet?
rounds.why: Each hand has 27 bones and each foot 26, for 106 in total.

rounds.q: What % of your body's calories does your brain burn?
rounds.why: Your brain is only about 2% of your body weight.

rounds.q: What % of all the cells in your body are red blood cells?
rounds.why: Fat and muscle cells are few in number but make up 75% of your total cell mass.

rounds.q: How many days does a typical red blood cell live?
rounds.why: Your body clears about 5 million red blood cells every second.
rounds.src: NIH PubMed Central, How Do Red Blood Cells Die?
